title: docs(skills): a gated action guards its door only; lock the field an irreversible transition changes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1XdbbGasMNVx41tq3hZKV4)_
Fixes #35068
Fixes #35041
Fixes #34237

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-ai 技能新增一条常见陷阱「只给动作加了闸,没锁状态字段」,教作者把不可逆状态迁移写成「需确认的 script 动作 + 状态字段锁(`readonly: true` 约束所有非系统写;字段权限不给 `editable` 不约束 Modify All 持有者),并在动作上声明 `requiredPermissions`」;工具名解析阶梯补上第四个来源 `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES`(docs 的 tools.mdx 同步);MCP prompts 段落写明 `mcpPrompt: false` 及 stdio 例外。
- 为什么改:`ai.requiresConfirmation` 只守动作这一扇门,场景卡上代理被 428 拒后改用 `update_record` 直接把工单关了;按「三个问题 同意」不扩大闸门,改为教作者锁字段。另两张 p3 卡是同文件的过期文字。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字与一行文档,不动任何代码与契约;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` 的 Common Pitfalls 第 2 条(锁选项是否与实测一致);其次同文件 MCP prompts 段落;`state-machines-and-approvals.md` 只多一行指针。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 objectstack-ai/SKILL.md 6693 / 6801、state-machines-and-approvals.md 5936 / 5936,全绿。
- 需要你做的:审阅后合并(`skills/**` 为 Tier H 受管面)。

## What changes

**#35068 — gated action plus a field lock.** Scope 1 was measured before any text was written (below). `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` Common Pitfalls gains item 2, "Gating the action, not the state": `ai.requiresConfirmation` guards the action's own door only; an irreversible transition is a gated `script` action over a field a non-system write cannot set: `readonly: true` binds every non-system caller, while a field permission without `editable` binds only a caller no held set grants it (Modify All grants it); the body skips the caller's edit right, so the action declares `requiredPermissions`; a declarative `operation: 'update'` action and a `flow` action under `runAs: 'user'` write as the caller, so the lock stops them too; `readonlyWhen` and a `state_machine` rule bind the elevated body as well, so neither is the door, while a `state_machine` dead-end still makes the reached state final. Pitfall 1 now says the confirmation gate guards its door only. `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` carries one pointer line to it (taught once, in objectstack-ai, where the gate is taught; no restatement).

**#35041 — the ladder's fourth source.** The resolution ladder names four sources; item 4 is `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES` (the pinned export in the same constants file, so the list cannot drift), resolved only for a skill MCP can offer (`mcpPrompt` not `false`). `content/docs/ai/tools.mdx` (the one ladder sentence, scope addition 6964629901) says the same.

**#34237 — `mcpPrompt` in the MCP prompts paragraph.** The paragraph names the optional key (`false` = in-product only, never offered over MCP on any connection, whatever the binding; absent or `true` = the binding rule), and the stdio sentence states the exception.

### Scope 1 measurement (tree 3fb7025c2 + this branch, no code changed)

| Writer | static `readonly: true` | `readonlyWhen` (TRUE) | field permission without `editable` | `state_machine` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `script` action body (`ctx.api`, elevated) | LANDS | STRIPPED | bypassed | enforced |
| raw data write as the caller (MCP `update_record`, REST, form) | STRIPPED | STRIPPED | refused 403 unless a held set grants `editable` (Modify All does) | enforced |
| declarative `operation: 'update'` action | STRIPPED (writes as the caller) | STRIPPED | refused 403 | enforced |

Anchors:
- The body runs elevated: `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:3901` (`buildActionExecutionContext` returns `{ ...ec, isSystem: true }` with the `'action'` mark).
- The static strip is gated on the context: `packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts:1411` (`staticReadonlyStripRuns = !opCtx.context?.isSystem`) and `:1494`.
- The conditional strip runs for every caller, `isSystem` included: `packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts:1476`; the comment at `:1460-1467` says `isSystem` "is still NOT an exemption here".
- Field-permission writes: the bypass is `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts:695` and the 403 is `:1662`.
- The declarative update writes as the caller: `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:4883` (`callData('update', …, ec)`, the comment above it reads "⛔ `ec`, never `buildActionExecutionContext(ec)`").
- The state machine is skipped only on seed replay or an explicit flag: `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts:4274-4275` (`shouldSkipStateMachine`).
- The same table is already measured in the header of `packages/lint/src/validate-readonly-action-writes.ts`.

Result: the action body's own write to a `readonly: true` field is KEPT and its write to a `readonlyWhen`-locked field is STRIPPED. So the lock that binds every non-system caller is `readonly: true`; a field permission without `editable` does not bind a Modify All holder; `readonlyWhen` is not the door. A `state_machine` rule binds every writer: it makes the state final, and it cannot be the door.

## Tests

Text-only change; no committed test (the measurement used existing pins, run here).

<details><summary>Scope 1 pins — objectql, 3 files, 25 tests passed</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-readonly-update-strip-system-gate.test.ts src/engine-readonly-when-derived-writes.test.ts src/engine-repo-execute-elevation.test.ts`, after building the objectql dependency closure. Output: `Test Files  3 passed (3)`, `Tests  25 passed (25)`, `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `engine-readonly-update-strip-system-gate.test.ts`: a caller-supplied `readonly` value lands exactly when `isSystem` is set.
- `engine-readonly-when-derived-writes.test.ts`, "LOCK 2 — isSystem does NOT exempt a caller-supplied value".
- `engine-repo-execute-elevation.test.ts`, "a readonly-field write through ctx.api LANDS, matching REST/MCP".
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Line budget, PAID DOWN FIRST in the same files. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`: the "Default for metadata apps" paragraph is cut, because it restated the App AI Blueprint table above it. The ladder item 1's ADR-0109 sentence is cut, because it restated *Tool metadata*. `state-machines-and-approvals.md`: three restatements are cut. The `[]` dead-end sentence restated the code comment `final — no outgoing transitions`; ", one per field" restated **One rule per field**; and "Do not carry the `record.x` habit…" restated the sentence before it. Fix round (af46d3bb1, review 6999708959 S1/S2): +42 tokens, paid first by cutting pitfall 1's retired-tool sentence (taught under Tool metadata) and folding the agents-are-internal lead into the skills-entry sentence; net 6680 -> 6693 / 6801.
- Neither ratchet row moves, so no ceiling is raised and the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068, letter B) is not invoked for a raise. The remainder fits under the existing ceilings.
- Scope 3 items (the 428 refusal text; the scenario build prompt) are other cards and are not touched here.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: reads every package's `dist/`); CI runs it.

## Verification

Readings at head 761128865 (tree objectstack-ai/objectstack).

<details><summary>Skills size, before (origin/main 3fb7025c2) and after</summary>

| File | lines | tokens / ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` | 443 → 462 | 6365 → 6693 / 6801 |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | 392 → 392 | 5936 → 5936 / 5936 (23744 → 23743 bytes) |
| all `skills/*/SKILL.md` (lines) | 4835 → 4854 | |
| bundle total (whole shipped tree, tokens) | | 270968 → 271283 |
</details>

<details><summary>Local gate subset — 74 derived families, 73 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

The list was derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against merge base 3fb7025c2, which gave 74 families. Every family ran, and the exit code was captured before any pipe.

- 73 families exit 0. Among them: `check:skills-token-ratchet`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-served-sections`, `check:skill-examples` (345 prose examples type-check), `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:docs` and `check:docs-spec-enumerations`.
- `check:skill-examples` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exited 3 on the first pass, because their built inputs were missing. Both exited 0 after `client-react` and `objectql` were built.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET.
- The reconciliation `dispatch-gates --ran` printed: `74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` printed `VERDICT clean exit 0`. It merges cleanly with origin/main, with #35129 (which shares the ai SKILL.md) and with #35002 (which shares the state-machines file).
</details>
